1.1: Yetziot hashshabbat shetayim shehen arba bifnim, ushetayim shehen arba bachutz. ketzad. heani omed bachutz uvaal habbayit bifnim, pashat heani et yado lifnim venatan letoch yado shel baal habbayit, o shennatal mittochah vehotzi, heani chayyav uvaal habbayit patur. pashat baal habbayit et yado lachutz venatan letoch yado shel ani, o shennatal mittochah vehichnis, baal habbayit chayyav veheani patur. pashat heani et yado lifnim venatal baal habbayit mittochah, o shennatan letochah vehotzi, shenehem peturin. pashat baal habbayit et yado lachutz venatal heani mittochah, o shennatan letochah vehichnis, shenehem peturin:
1.2: Lo yeshev adam lifne hassappar samuch lammincha, ad sheyyitpallel. lo yikkanes adam lammerchatz velo labburseki velo leechol velo ladin. veim hitchilu, en mafsikin. mafsikim likrot keriat shema, veen mafsikim lattefilla:
1.3: Lo yetze hachayyat bemachto samuch lachashecha, shemma yishkach veyetze. velo hallavlar bekulmoso. velo yefalle et kelav, velo yikra leor hanner. beemet amru, hachazzan roe hechan tinokot korim, aval hu lo yikra. kayyotze vo, lo yochal hazzav im hazzava, mippene hergel avera:
1.4: Veellu min hahalachot sheamru vaaliyyat chananya ven chizkiyya ven guryon keshealu levakkero. nimnu verabbu bet shammay al bet hillel, ushemona asar devarim gazru vo vayyom:
1.5: Bet shammay omrim, en shorin deyo vesammanim vecharshinim, ella kede sheyyishshoru mibbeod yom. uvet hillel mattirin:
1.6: Bet shammay omrim, en notnin unin shel pishtan letoch hattannur, ella kede sheyyahbilu mibbeod yom, velo et hatztzemer layyora, ella chede sheyyiklot haayin. uvet hillel mattirin. bet shammay omrim, en porsin metzudot chayya veofot vedagim, ella chede sheyyitztzodu mibbeod yom. uvet hillel mattirin:
1.7: Bet shammay omrim, en mochrin lannachri veen toanin immo veen magbihin alav, ella kede sheyyaggia lemakom karov. uvet hillel mattirin:
1.8: Bet shammay omrim, en notnin orot leabbedan velo chelim lechoves nachri, ella kede sheyyeasu mibbeod yom. uvechullan bet hillel mattirin im hashshamesh:
1.9: Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, nohagin hayu bet abba shehayu notnin kele lavan lechoves nachri shelosha yamim kodem lashshabbat. veshavin ellu vaellu, shettoanin korot bet habbad veiggule haggat:
1.10: En tzolin basar, batzal, uvetza, ella kede sheyyitztzolu mibbeod yom. en notnin pat lattannur im chashecha, velo charara al gabbe gechalim, ella kede sheyyikremu faneha mibbeod yom. rabbi eliezer omer, kede sheyyikrom hattachton shellah:
1.11: Meshalshelin et happesach battannur im chashecha. umaachizin et haur bimdurat bet hammoked. uvaggevulin, kede sheyyeechoz haur berubban. rabbi yehuda omer, befechamin, kol shehu:

2.1: Bamme madlikin uvamma en madlikin. en madlikin lo velechesh, velo vechosen, velo vechalach, velo viftilat haidan, velo viftilat hammidbar, velo viroka sheal pene hammayim. velo vezefet, velo veshaava, velo veshemen kik, velo veshemen serefa, velo vealya, velo vechelev. nachum hammadi omer, madlikin bechelev mevushshal. vachachamim omrim, echad mevushshal veechad sheeno mevushshal, en madlikin bo:
2.2: En madlikin beshemen serefa beyom tov. rabbi yishmael omer, en madlikin beitran, mippene chevod hashshabbat. vachachamim mattirin bechol hashshemanim, beshemen shumshemin, beshemen egozim, beshemen tzenonot, beshemen dagim, beshemen pakkuot, beitran uveneft. rabbi tarfon omer, en madlikin ella veshemen zayit bilvad:
2.3: Kol hayyotze min haetz en madlikin bo ella fishtan. vechol hayyotze min haetz eno mittamme tumat ohalim ella fishtan. petilat habbeged shekkippelah velo hivhavah, rabbi eliezer omer, temea, veen madlikin bah. rabbi akiva omer, tehora, umadlikin bah:
2.4: Lo yikkov adam shefoferet shel betza vimalenna shemen veyittenenna al pi hanner bishvil shettehe menattefet, afillu hi shel cheres. verabbi yehuda mattir. aval im chibberah hayyotzer mittechilla, muttar, mippene shehu cheli echad. lo yemalle adam et hakkeara shemen veyittenenna vetzad hanner veyitten rosh happetila vetochah, bishvil shettehe shoevet. verabbi yehuda mattir:
2.5: Hamechabbe et hanner mippene shehu mityare mippene goyim, mippene listim, mippene ruach raa, veim bishvil hachole sheyyishan, patur. kechas al hanner, kechas al hashshemen, kechas al happetila, chayyav. verabbi yose poter bechullan chutz min happetila, mippene shehu osah pecham:
2.6: Al shalosh averot nashim metot bishat ledatan, al sheenan zehirot bannidda uvachalla uvehadlakat hanner:
2.7: Shelosha devarim tzarich adam lomar betoch beto erev shabbat im chashecha. issartem. eravtem. hadeliku et hanner. safek chashecha safek en chashecha, en measserin et havvadday, veen matbilin et hakkelim, veen madlikin et hannerot, aval measserin et haddemay, umearvin, vetomnin et hachammin:

3.1: Kira shehissikuha vekash uvigvava, notnim aleha tavshil. begefet uveetzim, lo yitten ad sheyyigrof, o ad sheyyitten et haefer. bet shammay omrim, chammin aval lo tavshil. uvet hillel omrim, chammin vetavshil. bet shammay omrim, notlin aval lo machazirin. uvet hillel omrim, af machazirin:
3.2: Tannur shehissikuhu vekash uvaggevava, lo yitten ben mittocho ben meal gabbav. kuppach shehissikuhu vekash uvigvava, hare ze chechirayim, begefet uveetzim, hare hu chetannur:
3.3: En notnin betza vetzad hammecham bishvil shettitgalgel. velo yafkienna vesudarin. verabbi yose mattir. velo yatminenna vechol uvaavak derachim bishvil shettitztzale:
3.4: Maase sheasu anshe teverya veheviu sillon shel tzonen letoch amma shel chammin. amru lahen chachamim, im beshabbat, kechammin shehuchammu veshabbat, asurin birchitza uvishtiyya; beyom tov, kechammin shehuchammu veyom tov, asurin birchitza umuttarin bishtiyya. muleyar haggaruf, shotin hemennu veshabbat. antichi, af al pi sheggerufa, en shotin mimmenna:
3.5: Hammecham sheppinnahu, lo yitten letocho tzonen bishvil sheyyechammu, aval noten hu letocho o letoch hakkos kede lehafeshiran. hailpas vehakkedera sheheeviran meruttachin, lo yitten letochan tevalin, aval noten hu letoch hakkeara o letoch hattamchuy. rabbi yehuda omer, lakkol hu noten, chutz middavar sheyyesh bo chometz vetzir:
3.6: En notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel bo et hashshemen. veim notno mibbeod yom, muttar. veen neotin mimmennu, lefi sheeno min hammuchan. metaltelin ner chadash, aval lo yashan. rabbi shimon omer, kol hannerot metaltelin, chutz min hanner haddolek beshabbat. notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel nitzotzot. velo yitten letocho mayim, mippene shehu mechabbe:

4.1: Bamme tomnin uvamma en tomnin. en tomnin lo vegefet velo vezevel, lo vemelach velo vesid velo vechol, ben lachim ben yeveshim. lo veteven velo vezagim velo vemochim velo vaasavim bizman shehen lachim, aval tomnin bahen keshehen yeveshin. tomnin bichsut uveferot, bechanfe yona uvinsoret shel charashim uvinoret shel pishtan dakka. rabbi yehuda oser bedakka umattir begassa:
4.2: Tomnin bishlachin, umetaltelin otan, begizze tzemer, veen metaltelin otan. ketzad hu ose, notel et hakkissuy vehen noflot. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, kuppa, mattah al tziddah venotel, shemma yittol veeno yachol lehachazir. vachachamim omrim, notel umachazir. lo chissahu mibbeod yom, lo yechassennu mishshettechshach. kissahu venitgalla, muttar lechassoto. memalle et hakkiton venoten letachat hakkar, o tachat hakkaset:

5.1: Bamme behema yotza uvamma enah yotza. yotze haggamal beafsar, venaka vachatam, veluvdekis bifrumbeya, vesus besher, vechol baale hashsher yotzim bashsher venimshachim bashsher, umazzin alehen vetovlin bimkoman:
5.2: Chamor yotze vemardaat, bizman shehi keshura lo. zecharim yotzin levuvin. rechelot yotzot shechuzot, kevulot uchevunot. haizzim yotzot tzerurot. rabbi yose oser bechullan, chutz min harchelin hakkevunot. rabbi yehuda omer, izzim yotzot tzerurot leyabbesh, aval lo lechalav:
5.3: Uvamma enah yotza. lo yetze gamal bimtutelet, lo akud velo ragul, vechen shear kol habbehemot. lo yikshor gemallim ze vaze veyimshoch. aval machnis chavalim letoch yado veyimshoch, uvilvad shello yichroch:
5.4: En chamor yotze vemardaat bizman sheenah keshura lo, velo vezog, af al pi shehu fakuk, velo vesullam shebbetzavvaro, velo virtzua shebberaglo. veen hattarnegolin yotzin bechutin, velo virtzuot shebberaglehem. veen hazzecharim yotzin baagala shettachat haalya shellahen. veen harchelim yotzot chanunot. veen haegel yotze vegimon. velo fara beor hakkuppar, velo virtzua shebben karneha. parato shel rabbi elazar ben azarya hayta yotza virtzua shebben karneha, shello virtzon chachamim:

6.1: Bamme ishsha yotza uvamma enah yotza. lo tetze ishsha lo vechute tzemer velo vechute fishtan velo virtzuot shebberoshah. velo titbol bahen ad shetterappem. velo vetotefet velo vesanbutin bizman sheenan tefurin. velo vechavul lirshut harabbim. velo veir shel zahav, velo vekatla, velo vinzamim, velo vetabbaat sheen aleha chotam, velo vemachat sheenah nekuva. veim yatzat, enah chayyevet chattat:
6.2: Lo yetze haish besandal hamesummar, velo veyachid bizman sheen beraglo makka, velo vitfillin, velo vekamea bizman sheeno min hammumche, velo veshiryon, velo vekasda, velo vemaggafayim. veim yatza, eno chayyav chattat:
6.3: Lo tetze ishsha vemachat hannekuva, velo vetabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam, velo vecholyar, velo vechovelet, velo vitzlochit shel palyaton. veim yatzta, chayyevet chattat, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim potrin bechovelet uvitzlochit shel palyaton:
6.4: Lo yetze haish lo vesayif, velo vekeshet, velo vitris, velo vealla, velo veromach. veim yatza, chayyav chattat. rabbi eliezer omer, tachshitin hen lo. vachachamim omrim, enan ella lignay, shenneemar (yeshaya b) vechittetu charvotam leittim vachanitotehem lemazmerot, lo yissa goy el goy cherev velo yilmedu od milchama. birit, tehora, veyotzin bah beshabbat. kevalim, temein, veen yotzin bahem beshabbat:
6.5: Yotza ishsha vechute sear, ben mishshellah ben mishshel chavertah ben mishshel behema, uvetotefet uvesanbutin bizman shehen tefurin. bechavul uvefea nachrit lechatzer. bemoch shebbeaznah uvemoch shebbesandalah uvemoch shehitkina leniddatah. befilpel uvegargir melach uvechol davar shettitten letoch piha, uvilvad shello titten lechattechilla veshabbat. veim nafal, lo tachazir. shen totevet veshen shel zahav, rabbi mattir, vachachamim osrim:
6.6: Yotza vesela sheal hatztzinit. habbanot ketannot yotzot bechutin vaafillu vekismin shebbeaznehem. arviyyot yotzot reulot, umadiyyot perufot, vechol adam, ella sheddibberu chachamim bahove:
6.7: Porefet al haeven veal haegoz veal hammatbea, uvilvad shello tifrof lechattechilla veshabbat:
6.8: Hakkittea yotze vekav shello, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yose oser. veim yesh lo vet kibbul ketutim, tame. samochot shello, temein midras, veyotzin bahen beshabbat, venichnasin bahen baazara. kisse vesamochot shello, temein midras, veen yotzin bahen beshabbat, veen nichnasin bahen baazara. ankatmin tehorin, veen yotzin bahen:
6.9: Habbanim yotzin biksharim, uvene melachim bezogin. vechol adam, ella sheddibberu chachamim bahove:
6.10: Yotzin bevetzat hachargol, uveshen shual, uvemasmer min hatztzaluv, mishshum refua, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, af bechol asur, mishshum darche haemori:

7.1: Kelal gadol amru vashshabbat. kol hashshocheach ikkar shabbat veasa melachot harebe veshabbatot harebe, eno chayyav ella chattat echat. hayyodea ikkar shabbat veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe, chayyav al kol shabbat veshabbat. hayyodea shehu shabbat veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe, chayyav al kol av melacha umelacha. haose melachot harebe meen melacha achat, eno chayyav ella chattat echat:
7.2: Avot melachot arbaim chaser echat. hazzorea. vehachoresh. vehakkotzer. vehameammer. haddash. vehazzore. habborer. hattochen. vehamerakked. vehallash. vehaofe. haggozez et hatztzemer. hamelabbeno. vehamenappetzo. vehatztzovo. vehattove. vehammesech. vehaose shene vatte nirin. vehaoreg shene chutin. vehappotzea shene chutin. hakkosher. vehammattir. vehattofer shete tefirot. hakkorea al menat litpor shete tefirot. hatztzad tzevi. hashshochato. vehammafshito. hammolcho, vehameabbed et oro. vehammochako. vehamechattecho. hakkotev shete otiyyot. vehammochek al menat lichtov shete otiyyot. habbone. vehassoter. hamechabbe. vehammavir. hammakke vappattish. hammotzi mershut lirshut. hare ellu avot melachot arbaim chaser echat:
7.3: Veod kelal acher amru. kol hakkasher lehatzenia umatzniin kamohu vehotzio veshabbat, chayyav alav chattat, vechol sheeno chasher lehatzenia veen matzniin kamohu vehotzio veshabbat, eno chayyav ella hammatznio:
7.4: Hammotzi teven, kimlo fi fara. atza, kimlo fi gamal. amir, kimlo fi tale. asavim, kimlo fi gedi. ale shum vaale vetzalim, lachim, kigrogeret, yeveshim, kimlo fi gedi. veen mitztarfin ze im ze, mippene shello shavu veshiurehen. hammotzi ochalim kigrogeret, chayyav, umitztarfin ze im ze, mippene sheshshavu veshiurehen, chutz mikkelippehen vegarinehen veuktzehen vesubban umursanan. rabbi yehuda omer, chutz mikkelippe adashim shemmitbashshelot immahen:

8.1: Hammotzi yayin, kede mezigat hakkos. chalav, kede gemia. devash, kede litten al hakkatit. shemen, kede lasuch ever katan. mayim, kede lashuf bahem et hakkilor. ushear kol hammashkin, birviit. vechol hashshofachin, birviit. rabbi shimon omer, kullan birviit, velo amru chol hashshiurin hallalu ella lematzniehen:
8.2: Hammotzi chevel, kede laasot ozen lekuppa. gemi, kede laasot telay lenafa velichvara. rabbi yehuda omer, kede littol mimmennu middat minal lekatan. neyar, kede lichtov alav kesher mochsin. vehammotzi kesher mochsin, chayyav. neyar machuk, kede lichroch al pi tzelochit ketanna shel palyaton:
8.3: Or, kede laasot kamea. kelaf, kede lichtov alav parasha ketanna shebbattefillin, shehi shema yisrael. deyo, kede lichtov shete otiyyot. kechol, kede lichchol ayin echat:
8.4: Devek, kede litten berosh hashshavshevet. zefet vegafrit, kede laasot nekev. shaava, kede litten al pi nekev katan. charsit, kede laasot pi kor shel tzorfe zahav. rabbi yehuda omer, kede laasot pitput. subbin, kede litten al pi kor shel tzorfe zahav. sid, kede lasud ketanna shebbabbanot. rabbi yehuda omer, kede laasot kilkul. rabbi nechemya omer, kede laasot andife:
8.5: Adama, kechotam hammartzufim, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, kechotam haiggerot. zevel vechol haddak, kede lezabbel kelach shel keruv, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim, kede lezabbel keresha. chol haggas, kede litten al melo chaf sid. kane, kede laasot kulmos. veim haya av o merussas, kede levashshel vo vetza kalla shebbabbetzim, terufa unetuna vailpas:
8.6: Etzem, kede laasot tarvad. rabbi yehuda omer, kede laasot mimmennu chaf. zechuchit, kede ligror bo rosh hakkarkar. tzeror o even, kede lizrok beof. rabbi eliezer bar yaakov omer, kede lizrok bivhema:
8.7: Cheres, kede litten ben patztzim lachavero, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, kede lachtot bo et haur. rabbi yose omer, kede lekabbel bo reviit. amar rabbi meir, af al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar (yeshaya 30), velo yimmatze vimchittato cheres lachtot esh miyyakud. amar lo rabbi yose, mishsham reaya, velachsof mayim miggeve (sham):

9.1: Amar rabbi akiva, minnayin laavoda zara shehi metammea vemassa kannidda, shenneemar (yeshaya 30) tizrem kemo dava, tze tomar lo, ma nidda metammea vemassa, af avoda zara metammea vemassa:
9.2: Minnayin lisfina shehi tehora, shenneemar (Mishlei 30) derech oniyya velev yam. minnayin laaruga shehi shishsha al shishsha tefachim shezzorin betochah chamishsha zeronin, arbaa vearba ruchot haaruga veechad baemtza, shenneemar (yeshaya 61) ki chaaretz totzi tzimchah ucheganna zerueha tatzmiach, zarah lo neemar, ella zerueha:
9.3: Minnayin lefoletet shichvat zera bayyom hashshelishi shehi temea, shenneemar (Shemot 19) heyu nechonim lishloshet yamim. minnayin shemmarchitzin et hammila vayyom hashshelishi shechal lihyot beshabbat, shenneemar (Bereshit led) vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyotam koavim. minnayin shekkoshrin lashon shel zehorit berosh sair hammishtalleach, shenneemar (yeshaya 1) im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu:
9.4: Minnayin lesicha shehi chashshetiyya veyom hakkippurim, af al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar (tehillim kat) vattavo chammayim bekirbo vechashshemen beatzmotav:
9.5: Hammotzi etzim, kede levashshel betza kalla. tevalin, kede letabbel betza kalla, umitztarfin ze im ze. kelippe egozim, kelippe rimmonim, istis ufua, kede litzboa bahen beged katan bassevacha. me raglayim, neter uvorit, kimmonya veashlag, kede lechabbes bahen beged katan bassevacha. rabbi yehuda omer, kede lehaavir al hakkatem:
9.6: Pilpelet, kol shehu. veitran, kol shehu. mine vesamim umine mattachot, kol shehen. meavne hammizbeach umeafar hammizbeach, mekek sefarim umekek mitpechotehem, kol shehu, shemmatzniin otan leganzan. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammotzi mimmeshammeshe avodat kochavim, kol shehu, shenneemar (Devarim 13) velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem:
9.7: Hammotzi kuppat harochlin, af al pi sheyyesh bah minin harebe, eno chayyav ella chattat echat. zerone ginna, pachot mikkaggerogeret. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer, chamishsha. zera kishshuin, shenayim. zera deluin, shenayim. zera pol hammitzri, shenayim. chagav chay tahor, kol shehu. met, kaggerogeret. tzipporet keramim, ben chayya ben meta, kol shehu, shemmatzniin otah lirfua. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammotzi chagav chay tame, kol shehu, shemmatzniin oto lekatan lischok bo:

10.1: Hammatznia lezera uledugma velirfua, vehotzio beshabbat, chayyav bechol shehu. vechol adam en chayyav alav ella cheshiuro. chazar vehichniso, eno chayyav alav ella cheshiuro:
10.2: Hammotzi ochalin unetanan al haaskuppa, ben shechazar vehotzian ben shehotzian acher, patur, mippene shello asa melachto bevat echat. kuppa shehi melea ferot unetanah al haaskuppa hachitzona, af al pi sherov happerot mibbachutz, patur, ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkuppa:
10.3: Hammotzi ben bimino ben bismolo, betoch cheko o al ketefo, chayyav, shekken massa vene kehat. kilachar yado, beraglo, befiv uvemarpeko, beazno uvisaro, uvefundato ufiha lematta, ben pundato lachaluko, uvisfat chaluko, beminalo, besandalo, patur, shello hotzi kederech hammotziin:
10.4: Hammitkavven lehotzi lefanav uva lo leacharav, patur, leacharav uva lo lefanav, chayyav. beemet amru, haishsha hachogeret besinar ben millefaneha uven milleachareha chayyevet, shekken rauy lihyot chozer. rabbi yehuda omer, af mekabbele fitkin:
10.5: Hammotzi chikkar lirshut harabbim, chayyav. hotziuhu shenayim, peturin. lo yachol echad lehotzio vehotziuhu shenayim, chayyavim. verabbi shimon poter. hammotzi ochalin pachot mikkashshiur bichli, patur af al hakkeli, shehakkeli tefela lo. et hachay bammitta, patur af al hammitta, shehammitta tefela lo. et hammet bammitta, chayyav. vechen kazzayit min hammet vechazzayit min hannevela vechaadasha min hashsheretz, chayyav. verabbi shimon poter:
10.6: Hannotel tzipparnav zo vazo, o veshinnav, vechen searo, vechen sefamo, vechen zekano, vechen haggodelet, vechen hakkochelet, vechen happokeset, rabbi eliezer mechayyev, vachachamim osrin mishshum shevut. hattolesh meatzitz nakuv, chayyav, vesheeno nakuv, patur. verabbi shimon poter baze uvaze:

11.1: Hazzorek mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid, chayyav. mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid ureshut harabbim baemtza, rabbi akiva mechayyev, vachachamim potrin:
11.2: Ketzad. shete gezuzteraot zo cheneged zo virshut harabbim, hammoshit vehazzorek mizzo lazo, patur. hayu shetehen bidyota achat, hammoshit chayyav, vehazzorek patur, shekkach hayta avodat haleviyyim, shete agalot zo achar zo birshut harabbim, moshitin hakkerashim mizzo lazo, aval lo zorkin. chulyat habbor vehassela shehen gevohin asara verachban arbaa, hannotel mehen vehannoten al gabban, chayyav, pachot mikken, patur:
11.3: Hazzorek arba ammot bakkotel, lemala measara tefachim, kezorek baavir, lematta measara tefachim, kezorek baaretz. hazzorek baaretz arba ammot, chayyav. zarak letoch arba ammot venitgalgel chutz learba ammot, patur. chutz learba ammot, venitgalgel letoch arba ammot, chayyav:
11.4: Hazzorek bayyam arba ammot, patur. im haya rekak mayim ureshut harabbim mehallechet bo, hazzorek letocho arba ammot, chayyav. vechamma hu rekak mayim, pachot measara tefachim. rekak mayim ureshut harabbim mehallechet bo, hazzorek betocho arba ammot, chayyav:
11.5: Hazzorek min hayyam layyabbasha umin hayyabbasha layyam, umin hayyam lassefina umin hassefina layyam, umin hassefina lachavertah, patur. sefinot keshurot zo vazo, metaltelin mizzo lazo. im enan keshurot, af al pi shemmukkafot, en metaltelin mizzo lazo:
11.6: Hazzorek venizkar leachar sheyyatzta miyyado, kelatah acher, kelatah kelev, o shennisrefa, patur. zarak laasot chabbura, ben beadam ben bivhema, venizkar ad shello naasa chabbura, patur. ze hakkelal, kol chayyave chattaot enan chayyavin ad shettehe techillatan vesofan shegaga. techillatan shegaga vesofan zadon, techillatan zadon vesofan shegaga, peturin, ad shettehe techillatan vesofan shegaga:

12.1: Habbone, kamma yivne vihe chayyav, habbone kol shehu, vehamesattet, vehammakke vappattish uvemaatzad, hakkodeach kol shehu, chayyav. ze hakkelal, kol haose melacha umelachto mitkayyemet beshabbat, chayyav. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af hammakke vekurnas al hassaddan bishat melacha, chayyav, mippene shehu chimtakken melacha:
12.2: Hachoresh kol shehu, hamenakkesh vehamekarsem vehamezared kol shehu, chayyav. hamelakket etzim, im letakken, kol shehen, im lehessek, kede levashshel betza kalla. hamelakket asavim, im letakken, kol shehu, im livhema, kimlo fi haggedi:
12.3: Hakkotev shete otiyyot, ben bimino ben bismolo, ben mishshem echad ben mishshene shemot, ben mishshene sammaniyyot, bechol lashon, chayyav. amar rabbi yose, lo chiyyevu shete otiyyot ella mishshum roshem, shekkach hayu chotvin al karshe hammishkan, leda ezo ven zugo. amar rabbi, matzinu shem katan mishshem gadol, shem mishshimon ushemuel, noach minnachor, dan middaniyyel, gad miggaddiel:
12.4: Hakkotev shete otiyyot behelem echad, chayyav. katav bidyo, besam, besikra, bekomos uvekankantom, uvechol davar shehu roshem, al shene chatle zaviyyot veal shene luche finkas, vehen nehgin ze im ze, chayyav. hakkotev al besaro, chayyav. hamesaret al besaro, rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter:
12.5: Katav bemashkin, beme ferot, baavak derachim, baavak hassofrim, uvechol davar sheeno mitkayyem, patur. leachar yado, beraglo, befiv uvemarpeko, katav ot achat samuch lichtav, uchetav al gabbe chetav, nitkavven lichtov chet vechatav shene zaynin, echad baaretz veechad bakkora, katav al shene chatle habbayit, al shene dappe finkas veen nehgin ze im ze, patur. katav ot achat notarikon, rabbi yehoshua ben betera mechayyev, vachachamim potrin:
12.6: Hakkotev shete otiyyot bishne helemot, achat shacharit veachat ben haarbayim, rabban gamliel mechayyev, vachachamim potrin:

13.1: Rabbi eliezer omer, haoreg shelosha chutin battechilla veachat al haarig, chayyav. vachachamim omrim, ben battechilla ben bassof, shiuro shene chutin:
13.2: Haose shene vatte nirin bannirin, bakkeros, bannafa, bakkevara uvassal, chayyav. vehattofer shete tefirot, vehakkorea al menat litpor shete tefirot:
13.3: Hakkorea bachamato veal meto, vechol hamekalkelin, peturin. vehamekalkel al menat letakken, shiuro chamtakken:
13.4: Shiur hamelabben vehamenappetz vehatztzovea vehattove, kimlo rochav hassit kaful. vehaoreg shene chutin, shiuro kimlo hassit:
13.5: Rabbi yehuda omer, hatztzad tzippor lammigdal utzevi labbayit, chayyav. vachachamim omrim, tzippor lammigdal, utzevi labbayit velechatzer velabbevarin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo chol habbevarin shavin. ze hakkelal, mechussar tzida, patur, vesheeno mechussar tzida, chayyav:
13.6: Tzevi shennichnas labbayit venaal echad befanav, chayyav. naalu shenayim, peturin. lo yachol echad linol venaalu shenayim, chayyavin. verabbi shimon poter:
13.7: Yashav haechad al happetach velo milleahu, yashav hashsheni umilleahu, hashsheni chayyav. yashav harishon al happetach umilleahu, uva hashsheni veyashav betziddo, af al pi sheamad harishon vehalach lo, harishon chayyav vehashsheni patur. ha lema ze dome, lenoel et beto leshamro venimtza tzevi shamur betocho:

14.1: Shemona sheratzim haamurim battora, hatztzadan vehachovel bahen, chayyav. ushear shekatzim uremasim, hachovel bahen patur, hatztzadan letzorech, chayyav, shello letzorech, patur. chayya veof shebbirshuto, hatztzadan patur, vehachovel bahen chayyav:
14.2: En osin hilmi veshabbat, aval ose hu et me hammelach vetovel bahen pitto venoten letoch hattavshil. amar rabbi yose, vahalo hu hilmi, ben merubbe uven muat. veelu hen me melach hammuttarin, noten shemen battechilla letoch hammayim o letoch hammelach:
14.3: En ochlin ezov yon beshabbat, lefi sheeno maachal beriim, aval ochel hu et yoezer veshote abbuv roe. kol hoochalin ochel adam lirfua, vechol hammashkin shote, chutz mimme dekalim vechos ikkarim, mippene shehen layroka. aval shote hu me dekalim litzmao, vesach shemen ikkarin shello lirfua:
14.4: Hachoshesh beshinnav, lo yigma bahen et hachometz, aval metabbel hu chedarko, veim nitrappe nitrappe. hachoshesh bematnav, lo yasuch yayin vechometz, aval sach hu et hashshemen, velo shemen vered. bene melachim sachin shemen vered al makkotehen, shekken darkam lasuch bachol. rabbi shimon omer, kol yisrael bene melachim hem:

15.1: Ellu kesharim shechayyavin alehen, kesher haggammalin vekesher hassappanin. ucheshem shehu chayyav al kishshuran kach hu chayyav al hetteran. rabbi meir omer, kol kesher shehu yachol lehattiro veachat miyyadav, en chayyavin alav:
15.2: Yesh lecha kesharim sheen chayyavin alehen kekesher haggammalin uchekesher hassappanin. kosheret ishsha miftach chalukah, vechute sevacha veshel pesikya, uretzuot minal vesandal, venodot yayin vashemen, ukedera shel basar. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, koshrin lifne habbehema bishvil shello tetze. koshrin deli bifsikya, aval lo vechevel. rabbi yehuda mattir. kelal amar rabbi yehuda, kol kesher sheeno shel keyama, en chayyavin alav:
15.3: Mekappelin et hakkelim afillu arbaa vachamishsha feamim, umatztziin et hammittot millele shabbat leshabbat, aval lo mishshabbat lemotzae shabbat. rabbi yishmael omer, mekappelin et hakkelim umatztziin et hammittot miyyom hakkippurim leshabbat, vechelve shabbat kerevin beyom hakkippurim. (aval lo shel yom hakkippurim beshabbat). rabbi akiva omer lo shel shabbat kerevin beyom hakkippurim, velo shel yom hakkippurim kerevin beshabbat:

16.1: Kol kitve hakkodesh matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka, ben shekkorin bahen uven sheen korin bahen. veaf al pi shekketuvim bechol lashon, teunim geniza. umippene ma en korin bahen, mippene vittul bet hammidrash. matztzilin tik hassefer im hassefer, vetik hattefillin im hattefillin, veaf al pi sheyyesh betochan maot. ulehechan matztzilin otan, lemavoy sheeno mefullash. ben betera omer, af limfullash:
16.2: Matztzilin mezon shalosh seuddot, harauy leadam leadam, harauy livhema livhema. ketzad. nafla deleka velele shabbat, matztzilin mezon shalosh seuddot, beshacharit, matztzilin mezon shete seuddot, bemincha, mezon seudda echat. rabbi yose omer, leolam matztzilin mezon shalosh seuddot:
16.3: Matztzilin sal male chikkarot, veaf al pi sheyyesh bo mea seuddot, veiggul shel devela, vechavit shel yayin. veomer laacherim, bou vehatztzilu lachem. veim hayu fikchin, osin immo cheshbon achar hashshabbat. lehechan matztzilin otan, lechatzer hameorevet. ben betera omer, af lesheenah meoravet:
16.4: Ulesham motzi chol kele tashmisho, velovesh kol ma sheyyachol lilbosh, veotef kol ma sheyyachol laatof. rabbi yose omer, shemona asar kelim. vechozer velovesh umotzi, veomer laacherim, bou vehatztzilu immi:
16.5: Rabbi shimon ben nannas omer, porsin or shel gedi al gabbe shidda teva umigdal sheachaz bahen et haur, mippene shehu mecharech. veosin mechitztza bechol hakkelim, ben meleim ben rekanim, bishvil shello taavor haddeleka. rabbi yose oser bichle cheres chadashim melein mayim, lefi sheen yecholin lekabbel et haur vehen mitbakkein umechabbin et haddeleka:
16.6: Nachri shebba lechabbot, en omrim lo kabbe veal techabbe, mippene sheen shevitato alehen, aval katan shebba lechabbot, en shomin lo, mippene sheshshevitato alehen:
16.7: Kofin keara al gabbe hanner bishvil shello teechoz bakkora, veal tzoa shel katan, veal akrav shello tishshoch. amar rabbi yehuda, maase va lifne rabban yochanan ben zakkay baarav, veamar, choshshani lo mechattat:
16.8: Nachri shehidlik et hanner, mishtammesh leoro yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael, asur. mille mayim lehashekot behemto, mashke acharav yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael, asur. asa goy kevesh lered bo, yored acharav yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael, asur. maase verabban gamliel uzekenim shehayu vain bisfina, veasa goy kevesh lered bo, veyardu vo rabban gamliel uzekenim:

17.1: Kol hakkelim nittalin beshabbat vedaltotehen immahen, af al pi shennitparku veshabbat. sheenan domin ledaltot habbayit, lefi sheenan min hammuchan:
17.2: Notel adam kurnas lefatztzea bo et haegozim, vekurdom lachtoch et haddevela. megera, ligror bah et haggevina. magrefa, ligrof bah et haggerogarot. et harachat veet hammazleg, latet alav lekatan. et hakkush veet hakkarkar, litchov bo. machat shel yad, littol bo et hakkotz, veshel sakkaim, liftoach bo et haddalet:
17.3: Kane shel zetim, im yesh kesher berosho, mekabbel tuma, veim lav, en mekabbel tuma. ben kach uven kach, nittal beshabbat:
17.4: Rabbi yose omer, kol hakkelim nittalin, chutz min hammassar haggadol veyated shel macharesha. kol hakkelim nittalin letzorech veshello letzorech. rabbi nechemya omer, en nittalin ella letzorech:
17.5: Kol hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat, shivrehen nittalin immahen, uvilvad sheyyihyu osin meen melacha. shivre areva, lechassot bahen et pi hechavit. shivre zechuchit, lechassot bahen et pi happach. rabbi yehuda omer, uvilvad sheyyihyu osin meen melachtan. shivre areva, litztzok letochan mikpa. veshel zechuchit litztzok letochan shamen:
17.6: Haeven shebbekeruya, im memallein bah veenah nofelet, memallein bah. veim lav, en memallein bah. zemora shehi keshura vetafiach, memallein bah beshabbat:
17.7: Pekak hachallon, rabbi eliezer omer, bizman shehu kashur vetaluy, pokkin bo, veim lav, en pokkin bo. vachachamim omrim, ben kach uven kach pokkin bo:
17.8: Kol kissuye hakkelim sheyyesh lahem bet achiza nittalim beshabbat. amar rabbi yose, bamme devarim amurim. bechissuy karka, aval bechissuy hakkelim, ben kach uven kach nittalim beshabbat:

18.1: Mefannin afillu arba vechamesh kuppot shel teven veshel tevua mippene haorchim umippene vittul bet hammidrash, aval lo et haotzar. mefannin teruma tehora, udemay, umaaser rishon shennittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, vehatturmos hayyavesh, mippene shehu maachol laaniyyim. aval lo et hattevel, velo maaser rishon shello nittela terumato, velo et maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu, velo et halluf, velo hachardal. rabban shimon ben gamliel mattir beluf, mippene shehu maachal orvin:
18.2: Chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradim, im hitkinan lemaachal behema, metaltelin otan. veim lav, en metaltelin otan. kofin et hassal lifne haefrochim, kede sheyyaalu veyerdu. tarnegolet shebbarcha, dochin otah ad shettikkanes. medaddin agalin useyachin birshut harabbim. ishsha medadda et benah. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehu notel achat umeniach achat, aval im haya gorer, asur:
18.3: En meyalledin et habbehema veyom tov, aval mesaadin. umeyalledin et haishsha beshabbat, vekorin lah chachama mimmakom lemakom, umechallelin aleha et hashshabbat, vekoshrin et hattabbur. rabbi yose omer, af chotchin. vechol tzarche mila osin beshabbat:

19.1: Rabbi eliezer omer, im lo hevi cheli meerev shabbat, mevio veshabbat megulle. uvassakkana, mechassehu al pi edim. veod amar rabbi eliezer, kortin etzim laasot pechamin velaasot keli varzel. kelal amar rabbi akiva, kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat enah docha et hashshabbat, veshei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat docha et hashshabbat:
19.2: Osin kol tzarche mila veshabbat, mohalin, uforin, umotztzin, venotnin aleha ispelanit vechammon. im lo shachak meerev shabbat, loes beshinnav venoten. im lo taraf yayin veshemen meerev shabbat, yinnaten ze veatzmo veze veatzmo. veen osin lah chaluk lechattechilla, aval korech aleha semartut. im lo hitkin meerev shabbat, korech al etzbao umevi, vaafillu mechatzer acheret:
19.3: Marchitzin et hakkatan, ben lifne hammila uven leachar hammila, umezallefin alav bayyad, aval lo vichli. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, marchitzin et hakkatan bayyom hashshelishi shechal lihyot beshabbat, shenneemar (Bereshit led) vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyotam koavim. safek veanderoginos en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat, verabbi yehuda mattir beanderoginos:
19.4: Mi shehayu lo shete tinokot, echad lamul achar hashshabbat veechad lamul beshabbat, veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat beshabbat, chayyav. echad lamul beerev shabbat veechad lamul beshabbat, veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat beshabbat, rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter:
19.5: Katan nimmol lishmona, letisha, velaasara, uleachad asar, velishnem asar, lo fachot velo yoter. ha ketzad. kedarko, lishmona. nolad leven hashshemashot, nimmol letisha. ben hashshemashot shel erev shabbat, nimmol laasara. yom tov leachar hashshabbat, nimmol leachad asar. shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana, nimmol lishnem asar. katan hachole, en mohalin oto ad sheyyavri:
19.6: Ellu hen tzitzin hameakkevin et hammila, basar hachofe et rov haatara. veeno ochel batteruma. veim haya vaal basar, metakkeno mippene marit haayin. mal velo fara et hammila, keillu lo mal:

20.1: Rabbi eliezer omer, tolin et hameshammeret beyom tov, venotnin latteluya veshabbat. vachachamim omrim, en tolin et hameshammeret beyom tov, veen notnin latteluya veshabbat, aval notnin latteluya veyom tov:
20.2: Notnin mayim al gabbe hashshemarim bishvil sheyyitztzallu, umesannenin et hayyayin besudarin uvichfifa mitzrit, venotnin betza vimsannenet shel chardal, veosin enumelin beshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer, beshabbat, bechos, beyom tov, belagin, uvammoed, bechavit. rabbi tzadok omer, hakkol lefi haorchin:
20.3: En shorin et hachiltit befoshrin, aval noten letoch hachometz. veen shorin et hakkarshinin velo shafin otan, aval noten letoch hakkevara o letoch hakkalkalla. en kovrin et hatteven bichvara, velo yittenennu al gabbe makom gavoah bishvil sheyyered hammotz, aval notel hu vichvara venoten letoch haevus:
20.4: Gorfin millifne happetam, umesallekin litzdadin mippene hari, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim osrin. notlin millifne vehema zo venotnin lifne vehema zo beshabbat:
20.5: Hakkash sheal gabbe hammitta, lo yenaneo veyado, ella menaneo vegufo. veim haya maachal behema, o shehaya alav kar o sadin, menaneo veyado. machbesh shel baale vattim, mattirin, aval lo chovshin. veshel kovsin, lo yigga bo. rabbi yehuda omer, im haya muttar meerev shabbat, mattir et kullo veshomto:

21.1: Notel adam et beno vehaeven beyado, vechalkalla vehaeven betochah. umetaltelin teruma temea im hattehora veim hachullin. rabbi yehuda omer, af maalin et hamedumma beechad umea:
21.2: Haeven sheal pi hechavit, mattah al tziddah vehi nofelet. hayta ven hechaviyyot, magbiah umattah al tziddah vehi nofelet. maot sheal hakkar, noer et hakkar vehen noflot. hayta alav lashleshet, mekannechah bismartut. hayta shel or, notnin aleha mayim ad shettichle:
21.3: Bet shammay omrim, magbihin min hashshulchan atzamot ukelippin. uvet hillel omrim, notel et hattavla chullah umenaarah. maavirin millifne hashshulchan perurin pachot mikkazzayit vesear shel afunin vesear shel adashim, mippene shehu maachal behema. sefog, im yesh lo or bet achiza, mekannechin bo, veim lav, en mekannechin bo. vachachamim omrim ben kach uven kach, nittal beshabbat, veeno mekabbel tuma:

22.1: Chavit shennishbera, matztzilin hemenna mezon shalosh seuddot, veomer laacherim, bou vehatztzilu lachem, uvilvad shello yispog. en sochatin et happerot lehotzi mehen mashkin, veim yatzu meatzman, asurin. rabbi yehuda omer, im leochalin, hayyotze mehen muttar, veim lemashkin, hayyotze mehen asur. challot devash sherissekan meerev shabbat veyatzu meatzman, asurin. verabbi eliezer mattir:
22.2: Kol shebba vechammin meerev shabbat, shorin oto vechammin beshabbat, vechol shello va vechammin meerev shabbat, medichin oto vechammin beshabbat, chutz min hammaliach hayyashan, vedagim meluchim ketannim vekuleyas haispanin, shehadachatan zo hi gemar melachtan:
22.3: Shover adam et hechavit leechol hemenna gerogarot, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot keli. veen nokvim megufa shel chavit, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim mattirin. velo yikkevenna mitztziddah. veim hayta nekuva, lo yitten aleha shaava, mippene shehu memareach. amar rabbi yehuda, maase va lifne rabban yochanan ben zakkay baarav, veamar, choshshani lo mechattat:
22.4: Notnin tavshil letoch habbor bishvil sheyyehe shamur, veet hammayim hayyafim baraim bishvil sheyyitztzannu, veet hatztzonen bachamma bishvil sheyyechammu. mi shennashru chelav badderech bemayim, mehallech bahen veeno choshesh. higgia lechatzer hachitzona, shotchan bachamma, aval lo cheneged haam:
22.5: Harochetz beme meara uveme teverya venistappeg, afillu veeser alunetiot, lo yeviem beyado. aval asara vene adam mistappegin baalunetit achat penehem yedehem veraglehem, umeviin otah beyadan:
22.6: Sachin umemashmeshin bivne meayim, aval lo mitammelin velo mitgardin. en yordin lekordima, veen osin appiktevizin, veen meatztzevin et hakkatan, veen machazirin et hashshever. mi shennifreka yado veraglo, lo yitrefem betzonen, aval rochetz hu chedarko, veim nitrappa nitrappa:

23.1: Shoel adam mechavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen, uvilvad shello yomar lo haleveni, vechen haishsha mechavertah kikkarot. veim eno maamino, manniach tallito etzlo veose immo cheshbon leachar shabbat. vechen erev pesach birushalayim shechal lihyot beshabbat, manniach tallito etzlo venotel et pischo, veose immo cheshbon leachar yom tov:
23.2: Mone adam et orchav veet parperotav mippiv, aval lo min hakketav. umefis im banav veim bene veto al hashshulchan, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot mana gedola keneged ketanna, mishshum kuvya. umattilin chalashim al hakkadashim beyom tov, aval lo al hammanot:
23.3: Lo yiskor adam poalim beshabbat, velo yomar adam lachavero liskor lo foalim. en machshichin al hattechum liskor poalim ulehavi ferot, aval machshich hu lishmor, umevi ferot beyado. kelal amar abba shaul, kol sheani zakkay baamirato, rashshay ani lehacheshich alav:
23.4: Machshichin al hattechum lefakkeach al iske challa, veal iske hammet lehavi lo aron vetachrichin. goy shehevi chalilin beshabbat, lo yispod bahen yisrael, ella im ken bau mimmakom karov. asu lo aron vechafru lo kever, yikkaver bo yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael, lo yikkaver bo olamit:
23.5: Osin kol tzarche hammet, sachin umedichin oto, uvilvad shello yazizu vo ever. shomtin et hakkar mittachtav umattilin oto al hachol bishvil sheyyamtin. koshrim et hallechi, lo sheyyaale, ella shello yosif. vechen kora shennishbera, somchin otah besafsal o baarukkot hammitta, lo shettaale, ella shello tosif. en meammetzin et hammet beshabbat, velo vechol im yetziat nefesh. vehameammetz im yetziat nefesh, hare ze shofech damim:

24.1: Mi shehechshich badderech, noten kiso lenachri, veim en immo nachri, menicho al hachamor. higgia lechatzer hachitzona, notel et hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat, vesheenan nittalin beshabbat, mattir et hachavalim, vehassakkin noflin mealehem:
24.2: Mattirin pekie amir lifne vehema, umefaspesim et hakkefin, aval lo et hazzerin. en merassekin lo et hashshachat velo et hecharuvin lifne vehema, ben dakka ben gassa. rabbi yehuda mattir becharuvin laddakka:
24.3: En ovsin et haggamal, velo dorsin, aval malitin. veen mamrim et haagalim, aval malitin. umehalketin lattarnegolin. venotnin mayim lammursan, aval lo govlim. veen notnin mayim lifne devorim velifne yonim shebbashshovach, aval notnin lifne avazim vetarnegolim velifne yone hardesiyyot:
24.4: Mechattechin et haddeluin lifne habbehema, veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim. rabbi yehuda omer, im lo hayta nevela meerev shabbat, asura, lefi sheenah min hammuchan:
24.5: Mefirin nedarim beshabbat, venishalin lidvarim shehen letzorech hashshabbat. pokkin et hammaor, umoddin et hammatlit veet hammikve. umaase vime aviv shel rabbi tzadok uvime abba shaul ben batnit, sheppakku et hammaor betafiach, vekashru et hammekeda vegemi, leda im yesh baggigit poteach tefach im lav. umiddivrehen lamadnu, sheppokkin umoddin vekoshrin beshabbat:
